candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from payment authorization ReadTimeout: payment POST /v1/authorizations spans ~2s and errors with transport ReadTimeout, propagating 502 to /v1/orders and /v1/checkout, while inventory/redis calls succeed quickly.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side metrics/logs not admitted; root cause within payment (latency vs timeout config) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show payment authorization ReadTimeout causing 502 at order and checkout, with inventory/redis healthy. Metrics show checkout p95 ~2406ms and 502s. Bounded to downstream payment latency; payment internals unobserved.
